full_prompt_en: A finely detailed isometric illustration shows a small, warmly furnished room as an open cutaway against a dark brown background. Two coral-red walls meet at the back corner, enclosing a pale wooden floor whose exposed front edges form a shallow diamond. A tall teal cabinet stands along the left wall, with narrow glazed upper panels and solid lower doors. Beside it is a compact yellow-brown piano with a visible row of dark and light keys and a small wooden stool in front. Framed pictures cluster above this corner. A large oval mirror with a pale rim hangs on the right wall, its yellow surface containing indistinct reflected shapes. Below it, a low red-orange sofa has a mustard-yellow seat and rust-orange cushions. A broad-leafed plant in a brown pot stands at the sofa's right end. Fine leafy stems rise between the piano and sofa and trail around the mirror. Small ornaments, hanging strands, shelves, and framed decorations fill the upper wall areas without hiding the corner structure. A cream patterned rug spreads across the foreground floorboards, bordered by warm reddish tones. Thin dark contours describe furniture edges and decorative details, while small painted variations soften the broad color planes. Golden illumination warms the mirror, upholstery, and floor, with darker contact shadows under the furniture and in the corners. Coral and orange dominate, balanced by the cool teal cabinet and green foliage. The entire room remains visible at once, compact and richly arranged, with an inviting miniature quality.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅细节精致的等距插画，一间布置温暖的小房间以敞开剖面形式呈现在深棕背景上。两面珊瑚红墙在后方转角相接，围住浅色木地板，露出的前沿形成浅菱形。左墙边立着蓝绿色高柜，上部是细长玻璃门格，下部为实心柜门。旁边是一架小巧的黄棕色钢琴，深浅相间的琴键清晰可见，前方摆着小木凳；成组装框图片围在这一角上方。右墙悬挂浅边框的大椭圆镜，黄色镜面中含有模糊反射形状。镜下是低矮红橙色沙发，芥末黄坐垫配锈橙色靠垫；沙发右端放着棕色花盆中的阔叶植物。细枝绿叶从钢琴与沙发之间长起，并沿镜旁垂展。小饰物、悬挂细串、搁板和装框陈设填满墙面上部，但没有遮住房间转角结构。奶油色花纹地毯铺在前景木地板上，周边带暖红色调。细深轮廓描出家具边缘和装饰细节，小幅绘画色差柔化大色面。金色光感温暖镜面、软垫与地板，家具下方和墙角保留较深接触阴影。珊瑚红与橙色占主导，由冷蓝绿柜体及绿叶平衡。整个房间一览可见，紧凑而丰富，带有亲切的微缩空间感。
style_prompt_en: Richly colored painterly rendering combines coral red, burnt orange, golden yellow, and soft cream with selective teal and green counterpoints. Warm illumination links the bright planes, while muted brown shadows give them depth. Fine contour accents and small textured marks preserve detail without making every surface equally sharp. Broad color relationships remain coherent beneath denser local patterning. Soft transitions across curved forms coexist with firmer edges around compact geometric areas. A concentrated luminous region anchors the composition, with darker surrounding values supporting it. The result feels warm and intimate, balancing saturated color with believable tonal modeling and a gently handcrafted surface.
style_prompt_zh: 浓郁的绘画式表现结合珊瑚红、焦橙、金黄和柔和奶油色，并以少量蓝绿与绿色形成对照。暖色照明连接明亮色面，低调棕色阴影赋予纵深。精细轮廓与细小纹理保留细节，却不让所有表面同样锐利。局部密集图纹之下，大色彩关系仍然统一。弧形体块上的柔和过渡与紧凑几何区域的明确边缘并存。集中发亮的区域稳定构图，周围较深明度承托焦点。整体温暖而亲密，以可信明暗塑形和轻微手工质感平衡饱和色彩。
theme_en: A warm red isometric room with a teal cabinet, small piano, yellow oval mirror and orange sofa
theme_zh: 暖红色等距小房间，配蓝绿高柜、小钢琴、黄色椭圆镜和橙色沙发
name: Warm colors
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
